purpose: Dedicated records for canonical tree children and named analytical questions that are not promoted into data/nodes.json. These are real archive records, not UI placeholders.

records.name: Trajectory
records.description: A time-directed path through states or relationships. Trajectories must identify their observations, assumptions and time interval.

records.name: Path Dependence
records.description: A condition in which prior states constrain or alter later possibilities. It is a model of sequence and mechanism, not proof of inevitability.

records.name: Threshold
records.description: A boundary at which a system, state or relation changes regime. The underlying evidence or model must be specified.

records.name: Phase Transition
records.description: A change between distinguishable system regimes. Physical phase transitions must remain distinct from metaphorical or social state transitions.

records.name: Connection
records.description: An explicit relation between records, entities or states. Connection alone does not establish causality.

records.name: Coupling
records.description: A relation in which change in one component is linked to change in another according to an identified mechanism or model.

records.name: Flow
records.description: Directed movement of matter, energy, money, people, information or other specified quantities through a system.

records.name: Feedback
records.description: A loop in which outputs return to influence subsequent states. Positive and negative feedback must be distinguished.

records.name: Cycle
records.description: A closed path through a graph or recurring state sequence. Cyclic structure does not by itself imply recurrence in time.

records.name: Networks
records.description: Connected systems of nodes and edges analyzed for structure, flows, bridges, clusters and bottlenecks.

records.name: Dependencies
records.description: Conditions in which the function or state of one entity relies on another identified entity, resource, infrastructure or institution.

records.name: Topology
records.description: Study of connectivity, adjacency, boundaries, cycles, bridges and other structural properties under the declared representation.

records.name: System Phases
records.description: Named regimes or states through which a system passes. Each phase requires explicit criteria and evidence or model assumptions.

records.name: Entanglement
records.description: Structured relational coupling carrying metadata such as dependency, correlation, distance, feedback, topology, trajectory and phase. Quantum entanglement is a separate physical concept and is never inferred from ordinary network relation.

records.name: Plane
records.description: The horizontal field of manifested entities and interactions in the project-defined Axis terrain model.

records.name: Swamp
records.description: Project-defined high-entanglement, low-visibility terrain with overlapping flows, feedback and difficult boundaries; it is not a scientific classification.

records.name: Mud
records.description: Project-defined substrate associated with buried origins, material friction and unresolved potential; it is not a geological or causal claim.

records.name: Drain
records.description: A project-defined channel through which specified resources, energy, attention, information or meaning leave a system.

records.name: Roots
records.description: Project-defined hidden dependencies, history, inheritance, memory and support structures.

records.name: Hawkins Scale
records.description: A documented consciousness/emotion model with levels and symbolic colour. Its numerical calibrations are not validated physical Hertz measurements.

records.name: Emotion and State
records.description: Study of emotion, appraisal, action tendency, adaptive function, physiological correlates and transitions between psychological states.

records.name: Electromagnetic Spectrum
records.description: Physical electromagnetic radiation organized by frequency, wavelength and energy. It is kept separate from Hawkins numerical levels and symbolic colours.

records.name: Axis Topology
records.description: The project-defined spatial/topological vocabulary of Axis, Mountain, Plane, Mud, Swamp, Roots, Drain and Door used to describe orientation, visibility, flow, thresholds and structural relations.

records.name: Outcome
records.description: An observed, calculated or scenario result of a trajectory. Outcome records must identify their epistemic class and inputs.
